'''Viqui''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who was part of the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]] made by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During this period Viqui was stationed at [[Tower command station|Waypoint Station Aurek]] as commanding officer.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Viqui was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]] and may be encountered by Republic players.
